fields.System.Title: INT-403 — Dock-to-stock time
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a warehouse manager, I want the time from receipt to putaway tracked, so that I can
tell how quickly arriving stock becomes sellable.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a date range, then average and 95th-percentile dock-to-stock time is shown.
  • - Given the four-hour target, then the proportion breaching it is shown.
  • - Given the report, then it breaks down by supplier, zone, and hour of arrival.
  • - Given receipts still awaiting putaway, then they are included as in-progress with
  • their current age.
  • - Given this metric, then it reconciles with [INB-403](../INB/INB-403-dock-to-stock-report.md)
  • rather than computing it a second, different way.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform, inbound |
| Tables | throughput projection, receipt, putaway_task |
| Risks | Two reports computing the same metric differently |
| Tests | integration |
